title: What are Modules?
overview: A module is a Python file that contains reusable code such as functions, variables, and classes. Modules help organize large applications into smaller files.

title: Importing Modules
overview: Python allows importing modules to use their functions and variables in another file.

title: Different Import Methods
overview: Python provides different ways to import modules including importing the complete module or specific functions from a module.

example.title: Import Methods
example.content:
import math

from math import sqrt

from math import *

title: What are Packages?
overview: A package is a collection of related Python modules organized inside a directory. Packages help manage larger projects.

title: Installing External Packages
overview: Python uses pip to install third-party packages created by the developer community.

title: Topic Summary
overview: You learned how Python modules and packages organize reusable code and how external packages can be installed using pip.

example.title: Quick Revision
example.content:
✔ Modules contain reusable code.
✔ Packages group modules.
✔ import uses modules.
✔ pip installs external packages.
